meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把文章、笔记或主题等文字做成无面解说视频：没有真人出镜或实拍素材，每幕画面按内容设计排版、抽象图形、图表等，并依次产出分镜、脚本、音频、逐帧画面和成片。
howto.when: 当你把文章、笔记或主题等交给 Claude，请它做成无面解说视频时触发；适合概念拆解、操作指南、清单类内容。涉及要拍的网站或产品、或不确定时，由 /hyperframes 决定走哪条流程。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成无面解说视频
say.note: 会先走 /hyperframes 流程，再产出分镜。

say.text: 把我这段关于“机会成本”的笔记做成概念讲解视频
say.note: 会先生成故事板，确认后再继续。

say.text: 把这三点要点做成列表式无面科普短视频
say.note: 会按清单结构拆分并渲染成片。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns a text (article, notes, topic, brief) into a faceless explainer video: no site/footage to capture, visuals invented per scene (typography, graphics, diagrams). It makes storyboard, script, audio, frames, video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user supplies a text and asks for a faceless explainer video (topic explainer, concept, how-to). If a site/product must be captured, or unclear, /hyperframes takes over.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It runs the /hyperframes flow, then storyboard.

say_en.text: Break down the opportunity-cost concept from my notes into a video.
say_en.note: Drafts a storyboard and asks approval before rendering.

say_en.text: Make a listicle-style explainer from these three points.
say_en.note: Good for how-to/listicle; storyboard comes first.
